content.short: Harmonix Finance runs automated vault strategies aimed at maximising risk-adjusted returns.
content.description: Harmonix Finance runs automated vaults that apply hedge fund strategies on-chain, aimed at producing yield through both rising and falling markets. Its strategies include options-based and delta-neutral approaches designed to hold up when directional yield dries up. Depositors hold vault shares and see profit and loss reported in USDC. Positions on Hyperliquid also accrue the venue's points.
content.meta: Automated vaults on Hyperliquid that move the monitoring burden off the depositor.
